title: LC7 augmentation tensor model and LC6 handoff
status: Independent elementary model proof; source declarations read, no complete actual-model transport or Lean build audit claimed.

proof.base_lattice: Nonzero full projective O_K lattice W of positive rank h with positive definite hermitian metrics.
proof.metrics: Standard orthonormal metric on O_K^(T-1); inherited augmentation metric; product tensor metrics at every infinite place.
proof.slope: Standard O_K has slope zero; for a free rank-r integral basis with Gram G_v, mu=-(1/(r*[K:Q]/2))*sum_v log det G_v.
proof.empty_tensor: For f=0, both lattices equal W and the loss is zero.

retained_source_transport_hypotheses: Integral isomorphism to the induced coordinate model, not just a rational isomorphism.
Isometry for the given metrics at every infinite place.
Actual retained submodule equals the joint averaging kernel.
Actual residue multiplicative groups have T-1 elements and their number is f.
Actual source lattice is nonzero; source Pr.Ok and largeness hypotheses must be supplied.

cross_audit.LC2: Correct; saturation gives Mprime intersect a^tau M=a^tau Mprime and the tail quotient injects into a^tau M/Nstar.
cross_audit.LC5: Correct after explicitly requiring 0<r_u<=d_u and 0<=delta<1 before division by 1-delta.
cross_audit.LC6: Correct assuming IO,Ta>=0, delta in [0,1/2], delta<=2f/T, Ta<=b^2 and mean-loss plus 4fb^2/T<=1; yields loss 2IO+B+R+1, hence 4IOp+B+R+1.
